messages:
ashley: heads up — skyforge (cloud marketplace partner) pinged: customer integrations started failing after our v3 client rollout yesterday. stack traces point to an `x-rdwd-auth` -> `authorization` header rename. :frowning:

miguel: :eyes: i can repro locally with their SDK. request is rejected at auth layer — our v3 only accepts `Authorization: Bearer` now, old SDKs still send `X-RDWD-AUTH`.

suresh: hmm we flipped the header normalize in the client to align with oauth best-practices. we should be tolerant for a short window.

ellie: timeline wise partner marketplace update went out with the new client flag yesterday. partners were supposed to have 72h to opt-in. clearly that didn't happen for some of their SIs.

ashley: immediate ask: can we either rollback the change or accept both headers server-side until partners upgrade? partner wants a short remediation plan + comms.

miguel: rollback would require another deploy and could reintroduce the old behavior. easier: add a small compatibility shim in the auth gateway that maps `x-rdwd-auth` -> `Authorization` for now. patch and canary it.

suresh: agree. i'll scope a gateway shim: if header present AND no `Authorization`, set `Authorization: Bearer <value>`. will add a flag `compat.accept_x_rdwd_auth=true`. canary in us-west-2 first.

ellie: good. i'll draft a partner-facing note: timeline, mitigation steps, recommended SDK update, and sample curl. want to include rollback option in case shim causes regressions.

skyforge-support: thanks — we'll queue our SDK teams. estimated 36–48h to cut a release for embedded SI customers, but marketplace customers should be able to update faster. this will help.

miguel: sample shim logic (for ops):
```
if (!req.headers.authorization && req.headers['x-rdwd-auth']) {
  req.headers.authorization = `Bearer ${req.headers['x-rdwd-auth']}`
}
```

ashley: nice. ellie can you include that snippet and a short compatibility matrix in the comms? also include target dates: shim live within 3 hours, canary 30m, full rollout 2h if no errors.

ellie: will do. draft plan:
- 0h: enable compatibility flag in canary (us-west-2)
- +30m: verify logs for acceptance and any 401 regressions
- +2h: full rollout to prod if stable
- +24–72h: partners migrate SDKs; we monitor
- +60d: remove shim (final deprecation) — send formal deprecation notice now and again at +30d

suresh: i'll wire up a metric `auth.compat_header_used` and an alert if it exceeds 0.5% error delta during rollout. also add a trace tag to requests using shim so we can follow partner impact.

miguel: breaking-change note for eng: we should add a compatibility test to our CI that validates both headers for a minor release window. avoids surprises.

ashley: comms checklist i'm adding to partner message: short explainer, sample code (curl and sdk snippet), migration steps, estimated timeline, contact for support (skyforge-support), link to marketplace page update, and escalation matrix.

ellie: i'll post to partners channel and send direct email to top-10 SI accounts. draft link: https://go.redwood.dev/compat-notice/2112345678 (will replace with final).

deploy-bot: [deployment] auth-gateway-compat-shim v1.0 started canary in us-west-2 at 2112345800.

miguel: canary logs look clean — acceptance tests pass, no 401 spike. rolling to prod now.

deploy-bot: [deployment] auth-gateway-compat-shim v1.0 rolled to prod at 2112345880.

suresh: metrics show ~0.8% of requests using shim globally (mostly from skyforge-marketplace customers). good signal that partners are still staggered.

ashley: ok action items: ellie draft+send comms (ETA 1h), miguel monitor for 24h and prepare rollback if needed, suresh instrument alert and plan removal timeline, i'll follow up with skyforge contact.

ellie: sending initial note now. will ping thread with final copy. :thumbsup:

skyforge-support: thanks team — we'll hold off forcing SDK updates until confirm. appreciate the quick turnaround.

ashley: reopening longer-term discussion: we need a formal partner-compat playbook for header/name changes. propose: 60d minimum deprecation with mandatory marketplace banner and auto-compat shim for 7d grace during rollout. open to feedback.

miguel: +1 to playbook. prefer also an automated canary checklist so engs don't have to re-think every time.

suresh: will draft a playbook PR after this incident.

ashley: thanks all — closing thread after comms posted.
